FN-LOGUAY-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 364
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Steve Hurst
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/24/2023
House Bill 364 as introduced would require a public K-12 school or local board of education to
accept cash along with any other form of payment of its choosing, for admission to
school-sponsored sporting events. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local
funding.
Page 1
